attr.title: Yuppie Psycho: Executive Edition
attr.desc: Brian Pasternack is a young man with no future in a dystopian 90s society. His life is about to change on his first day at Sintracorp, one of the largest companies in the world. It's a strange, unsettling place, and Brian is hired for an unexpected task: to hunt the witch that haunts the building.
attr.inst: Requires Yuppie Psycho v2.5 or newer (the MonoGame engine). Best: run the patcher on a PC (yuppiepsycho/patch.bat on Windows, ./patch on Linux and macOS) and pick your handheld; it copies the game from Steam and prepares it in a few minutes. Or copy the complete game folder from Steam (Linux build preferred, Windows build also works) into yuppiepsycho/gamedata; the first launch then converts the files on the handheld, which takes 5 to 30 minutes.
attr.inst_md:
- Requires **Yuppie Psycho v2.5 or newer** (the MonoGame engine).
- Best: run the patcher on a PC (`yuppiepsycho/patch.bat` on Windows, `./patch` on Linux and macOS) and pick your handheld. It copies the game from Steam and prepares it in a few minutes.
- Or copy the **complete** game folder from Steam (Linux build preferred, Windows build also works) into `yuppiepsycho/gamedata`; the first launch then converts the files on the handheld (5 to 30 minutes).
